```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(mocapr)

files <- list.files("mocap_02", pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
files

read_one <- function(f) {
  import_captury_csv(f) |>
    filter(!is.na(frame)) |>
    mutate(skeleton = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f)), .before = 1)
}
sess <- map(files, read_one) |> list_rbind()

qom6 <- sess |>
  group_by(skeleton) |>
  arrange(frame, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(step_mm  = sqrt((CGX - lag(CGX))^2 + (CGZ - lag(CGZ))^2),
         speed_ms = step_mm / 1000 * 50) |>
  ungroup()

qom6 |> group_by(skeleton) |> summarise(jumps = sum(speed_ms > 4, na.rm = TRUE))

swap_ids <- function(data, a, b, from_s, to_s = Inf)
  data |>
    mutate(skeleton = case_when(
      time_seconds >= from_s & time_seconds < to_s & skeleton == a ~ b,
      time_seconds >= from_s & time_seconds < to_s & skeleton == b ~ a,
      .default = skeleton
    ))
   
   sess_fixed <- sess |>
  swap_ids("Kevin", "Luc", from_s = 61.4) |>
  swap_ids("Alexia", "Sol", from_s = 80.2, to_s = 85.0)

sess_fixed <- sess |>
  swap_ids("Kevin", "Luc", from_s = 61.4)

cg <- sess |> select(frame, time_seconds, skeleton, CGX, CGZ)

close_frames <- inner_join(cg, cg, by = c("frame", "time_seconds"),
                           suffix = c("_a", "_b"), relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  filter(skeleton_a < skeleton_b) |>
  mutate(dist_m = sqrt((CGX_a - CGX_b)^2 + (CGZ_a - CGZ_b)^2) / 1000) |>
  filter(dist_m < 0.5)

events <- close_frames |>
  group_by(skeleton_a, skeleton_b) |>
  arrange(frame, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(event = cumsum(frame - lag(frame, default = -Inf) > 25)) |>
  group_by(skeleton_a, skeleton_b, event) |>
  summarise(start_s   = min(time_seconds),
            end_s     = max(time_seconds),
            closest_m = min(dist_m),
            .groups = "drop")

events

sess |>
  filter(skeleton %in% c("Bahar", "Luc", "Simon"),
         time_seconds > 30, time_seconds < 50) |>
  pivot_longer(c(CGX, CGZ), names_to = "axis", values_to = "pos") |>
  ggplot(aes(time_seconds, pos, colour = skeleton)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ axis, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y")

sess_fixed <- sess |>
  filter(!(skeleton == "Luc" & time_seconds >= 38.0))

sess_fixed |>
  group_by(skeleton) |>
  summarise(last_s = max(time_seconds), n = n())

events <- close_frames |>
  group_by(skeleton_a, skeleton_b) |>
  arrange(frame, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(event = cumsum(frame - lag(frame, default = -Inf) > 25)) |>
  group_by(skeleton_a, skeleton_b, event) |>
  summarise(start_s   = min(time_seconds),
            end_s     = max(time_seconds),
            closest_m = min(dist_m),
            .groups = "drop")

events

sess_fixed |> filter(skeleton == "Luc") |> summarise(last_s = max(time_seconds))
```
